params.body:
## What

Follow-up to #869. On the Kaart tab of Inzichten the province table was cut off by its card on desktop: at 1440 the share column read "AANDEEI" with its values clipped at the right edge, and the used-car registrations column was not visible at all. The table did scroll, but nothing showed that it did.

## Why

The table has eight columns and needs about 660px. The row was split with fixed fractions (`1.15fr` map, `1fr` table), which left the table 520px at 1280 and 594px at 1440.

## Change (styling only, one blade)

- The row is `minmax(0,1fr)` for the map and `minmax(0,max-content)` for the table: the table column takes the width of the table, the map takes what is left. Side by side from `xl` (1280), stacked below that.
- The notes under the table are `w-[0px] min-w-full`, so their long lines wrap to the table instead of widening the card.
- The table cells on this tab use 6px instead of 10px horizontal padding (`[&_th]:px-[6px] [&_td]:px-[6px]`), which brings the table from 719px to 655px.
- On a phone the table still scrolls inside its card (`overflow-x-auto`), and the page does not scroll sideways.

Tailwind classes in the blade only. `insights.css` and `refresh.css` are not touched, and no business rule changes.

## Measured

Rendered the partial with the built CSS and JS and sample data (548 accounts), table width against the width available to it:

| viewport | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| 1280 | 719 in 520 (clipped) | 655 in 655 |
| 1440 | 719 in 594 (clipped) | 655 in 655 |
| 390 | 719 in 318, scrolls in the card | 655 in 318, scrolls in the card; page 390 wide |

The map is 513px wide at 1280 and 673px at 1440.

## Tests

`npm ci && npm run build`, then the Insights tests, `TheMapTabShowsWhereTheNetworkIsTest`, `BuildContractTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `QualityRatchetTest` and `LanguageParityTest` locally: 42 tests pass. The one incomplete test is the existing report of missing Spanish keys.
params.title: Inzichten map tab: the province table fits its card
